acceptance_checks.given: a Month containing an event title wider than its day
acceptance_checks.then: every week SHALL retain seven equal-width columns, the title SHALL ellipsize inside its cell, and the event control SHALL retain the complete accessible title
acceptance_checks.verify_method: calendar controller tests, CSS assertions, and visual QA

acceptance_checks.given: Jin and Google timed and all-day events
acceptance_checks.then: the shared surface SHALL use color-led styling without visible G or J glyphs while preserving source meaning and time-grid behavior
acceptance_checks.verify_method: calendar controller and time-grid tests plus visual QA

acceptance_checks.given: two Google calendars with the same display name but different account and calendar IDs
acceptance_checks.when: preferences are stored and events render
acceptance_checks.then: each exact route SHALL retain an independent color across Month, Week, Day, and all-day presentation

acceptance_checks.given: an open calendar and Calendar Accounts settings
acceptance_checks.then: local storage SHALL contain the normalized preference and the open calendar SHALL rerender without refetching events

acceptance_checks.given: calendar, list, and tag color controls
acceptance_checks.then: all SHALL use the shared picker with eight presets followed by one chroma control
acceptance_checks.verify_method: picker DOM tests and source inspection

acceptance_checks.when: the chroma control is reopened and the picker is destroyed
acceptance_checks.then: at most one lazy Jin modal SHALL be owned, focus SHALL restore, and modal resources SHALL be removed

acceptance_checks.when: HEX or RGB drafts are edited, committed, or invalid
acceptance_checks.then: valid input SHALL synchronize without disrupting caret or composition, shorthand SHALL canonicalize on commit, and invalid input SHALL not reach styling or persistence
acceptance_checks.verify_method: picker draft, IME, validation, and Apply tests

acceptance_checks.when: Hue, Saturation, or Brightness changes through map, keyboard, or native ranges
acceptance_checks.then: spectrum, preview, outputs, ARIA values, and marker SHALL synchronize and values SHALL clamp to bounds
acceptance_checks.verify_method: picker interaction tests and visual QA

acceptance_checks.given: an existing committed color and a changed custom draft
acceptance_checks.when: the dialog is dismissed or Apply is activated
acceptance_checks.then: dismissal SHALL emit no mutation and Apply SHALL emit exactly one canonical color

acceptance_checks.given: palette, custom, invalid, and unknown legacy values
acceptance_checks.then: only semantic palette state or validated canonical HEX SHALL enter the designated CSS property and invalid values SHALL fall back safely

acceptance_checks.given: list create or edit color input
acceptance_checks.when: core receives a palette token, valid HEX, or invalid color
acceptance_checks.then: core SHALL persist normalized valid colors and reject invalid colors before mutation

acceptance_checks.when: core recolor receives a valid or invalid color
acceptance_checks.then: valid values SHALL persist canonically and invalid values SHALL preserve prior color
acceptance_checks.verify_method: jin-core tag color tests and GUI callbacks

acceptance_checks.then: badges SHALL derive structure from jin-badge while preserving semantic cues and excluding interactive chips
acceptance_checks.verify_method: DOM and source assertions plus visual QA

acceptance_checks.given: supported themes, accessibility modes, and viewport widths
acceptance_checks.when: affected calendar and color surfaces are exercised
acceptance_checks.then: controls SHALL remain legible, contained, focus-visible, operable, and repository release gates SHALL pass
acceptance_checks.verify_method: make verify-all and GUI visual evidence
